faqData.question: What is wood industry ERP?
faqData.answer: A dedicated wood industry ERP helps manufacturers manage raw timber, furniture components and custom-made designs while tracking production, inventory and finances seamlessly.

faqData.question: How does ERP software help in wood manufacturing?
faqData.answer: It automates procurement, optimizes cutting plans, schedules production and tracks inventory to minimize waste and improve efficiency.

faqData.question: Can this ERP handle custom furniture orders?
faqData.answer: Yes. Our custom furniture ERP allows you to manage detailed specifications, customer preferences and finish options in one place.
